cases.notes: G01 fixture for string queries: one method references "token" (code unit 0) and "tokens" (code unit 2). The single-hit anchor case is the ^token$ query. Literal queries compare UTF-16 substrings, so literal "tok.n" hits nothing. code_unit_offsets count 16-bit code units from the start of the method's insns array (instruction start).
